{{Quote|This data cylinder is old and badly damaged but I can make out something about a cache of data cylinders and a location pointer to something called a... temple of the stars? The name is difficult to read but I think that is correct.|[[Rubina]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:LB" />}}
The '''Temple of the Stars''' was a [[Star Temple]] located in the [[Yumaou Risoath]] region of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], [[Rubina]] tasked a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] with retrieving a cache of [[Code cylinder/Legends|data cylinders]] from the temple. The temple was inhabited by creatures called the [[Blue Forest People]] and a giant [[whuffa worm]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Temple of the Stars was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:LB" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Temple of the Stars was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Witches of Dathomir Theme Park|Witches of Dathomir Theme Park]]," introduced with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Game Update 19|Game Update 19]]," on [[December 14]], [[2010]].<ref name="GU19">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=1160720|text=''Star Wars'' Galaxies: Game Update 19}}</ref> The Temple of the Stars reused the 3D model of the [[Temple of the Blueleaf Cluster/Legends|Temple of the Blueleaf Cluster]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].<ref name="SWG:TTotB">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=poi|The Temple of the Blueleaf|Yavin 4}}</ref>
